library.description: Store dependency tracing, snapshots, and time travel diagnostics.

blocks.text: 给已有 Store 接上有界本地历史、状态回放和动作追踪，并直接查看真实响应式依赖。

items: 回到旧状态就多出一条新历史，因为普通变更监听把回放写入也当成用户修改。
动作说明挤掉需要的状态，因为历史和追踪没有独立保留上限。
调试快照失败后业务写入也抛错，因为诊断回调没有与业务路径隔开。
调试面板关闭就把 Store 一起销毁，因为会话与应用资源的所有权混在一起。
共享依赖的第二条路径消失，因为全局已访问集合把菱形共享误当成环。
回放状态，不重复记录同步回放历史。 不必在普通变更监听旁另补回放开关，例子跳回初始状态后历史条数不变，后续编辑仍记录，见同名场景。
历史和动作分别保留最近条目。 不把动作说明与状态挤进同一容量，例子显示独立淘汰并在 clear 后保留递增 id，见同名场景。
自动快照失败上报，当前业务写入仍完成。 不让调试回调错误冒泡破坏这次写入，例子同时验证原错身份、手动抛错和恢复后的 id，见同名场景。
释放诊断会话，保留应用拥有的 Store。 不把关闭面板等同于销毁状态，例子释放后历史停止增长而 Store 仍接受写入，见同名场景。
共享依赖保留两条真实路径。 不使用全局访问集合误截菱形分支，例子用真实 Runtime 节点展开两条路径并检查深度零边界，见同名场景。

blocks.text: 输出：
需要限制队列时看分别限制历史与手动动作队列，需要查重算来源时看展开共享依赖的两条路径。

createStore 以 count: 0 初始化，未指定 runtime 时借用默认 Runtime；显式 flush 让这次变更的通知完成后再回放。captureRuntimeTrace 设为 false，覆盖缺省启用；maxHistory / maxTrace 默认 100 / 1000，clone 默认 diagnostic，now 默认 Date.now，最后分别释放会话和 Store。
同一状态回放场景，下面只展示，不运行：

blocks.code:
import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'

const store = createStore({ count: 0 })
const history = [store.$plain()]
const off = store.$subscribe(() => history.push(store.$plain())) // 历史无保留上限
store.count = 1
store.$runtime.flush()
store.$hydrate(history[0]!)
store.$runtime.flush() // 回放通知又追加历史，无法区分用户编辑
void off // 面板关闭后仍未解绑订阅

blocks.text: 上一节通过 jumpTo 的同步回放屏蔽避免新增回放历史，并在 finally 中释放诊断订阅；Store 仍由创建者单独释放。这个手写片段只展示同一场景的隐患，不运行。

blocks.text: 本包是已有 Store 的本地诊断会话，不创建 Store，不改写或代理写入路径。它使用 Store 的 $subscribe、$runtime.subscribeTrace / reportError、$plain、$hydrate，记录内存历史和 action，另提供两个不依赖会话的响应式图遍历函数。适合排查字段变化、动作失败和节点依赖，不是持久化审计、网络回放或外部副作用的事务回滚。
唯一入口为 `@migaia/store-devtools`，导出 createStoreDevTools、getDependencyTree、getObserverTree、五种公开数据类型、错误码与三个错误工厂。reactive、store-light、store-middleware、utils 是运行时依赖；示例直接导入 reactive / store-light 时仍应直接安装它们。

本包不实现浏览器扩展协议。要连接 Redux DevTools，使用 Store Middleware 的 createReduxDevToolsAdapter / connectDevTools。原 StoreDevtoolsCommand / IStoreDevtoolsCommand 已移出此入口；自建桥接改为从 store-middleware 导入 ReduxDevToolsCommand / IReduxDevToolsCommand。六个协议值保持 DISPATCH、COMMIT、JUMP_TO_STATE、JUMP_TO_ACTION、ROLLBACK、RESET；这是导入位置的迁移，不是新增协议层。
`createStoreDevTools<S>(store, options?)` 同步返回 IStoreDevTools。store 必须是 createStore 返回的真实 `IReactiveStore<S>`；会话借用 Store 和 Runtime，不拥有或销毁它们。options 省略为空对象。

rows: 100；仅限制 history，必须是正安全整数。
1000；分别限制 actions 和 trace 的独立队列，没有 maxActions。
缺省启用；只有严格等于 false 才完全跳过 Runtime trace 订阅，actions 也不再自动填充。
Date.now；为历史和 action 记录提供时间戳，显式提供时必须是函数。
ClonePolicy.diagnostic；接收 $plain() 或历史 state 并返回记录对象，显式提供时必须是函数。

blocks.text: null / 非对象 options 以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝；反射或 option 属性读取失败也使用该码，并在 cause 保留捕获的原错。构造读取描述符后读取五个选项，getter 可能在这些属性读取中执行；它不是“完全不执行 getter”的接纳方式。maxHistory / maxTrace 经空值回退后校验，不把 0、负数、分数、无穷或 NaN 静默夹到合法值。now / clone 的非函数配置同样在订阅前拒绝。

通过配置校验后，先同步创建第一条 initial 历史，再订阅当前 Store 的粗粒度状态通知。开启 trace 时订阅的是这个 Store 所用的整个 Runtime，因此共享 Runtime 上其他 Store 或 runTracedAction 的动作也可能进入 actions / trace；它们不自动按本 Store 身份过滤。配置失败不建立订阅；订阅建立失败则尝试释放已取得订阅，主错与回滚错误的保留方式见错误章节。

rows: 每次读取返回按时间顺序排列的新冻结数组，元素为 IStoreHistoryEntry。
label 默认 state change；先准备时间戳和状态，再分配 id、追加记录，并返回该条目。
必填历史 id；找不到（含已裁剪）抛 UNKNOWN_HISTORY_ENTRY RangeError，找到则 clone(state) 后交给 Store 的 $hydrate。
无参数；先准备新的 initial，再清三队列并发布这一条，id 继续递增，不归零。

blocks.text: IStoreHistoryEntry 含 id、timestamp、label、state；公开字段类型没有额外 readonly 修饰，但发布时 entry 与 state 顶层实际冻结。history 的数组快照不随之后入队而变化，嵌套 state 的隔离程度由 clone 决定，不保证任意对象图深冻结。超出 maxHistory 后淘汰最早条目，包括 initial；保留已裁剪 id 也不能继续 jumpTo。

默认 record 从 clone(store.$plain()) 取状态。$plain 只包含 Store 的 signal 支撑字段，不含 computed、方法或 WASM 字段。默认 diagnostic clone 通过公共 structured-clone-first owner 尽力复制；不可克隆或不安全子树可能保持引用，自定义类也不保证原型保持。它不自动脱敏；需要剔除 token 等字段时，应用应提供明确的 clone，或不让敏感值进入可记录状态。
record / clear 的准备失败不发布半条历史，也不消耗下一个 id；clear 准备失败保留全部旧队列。准备完成后还会检查会话是否已被回调释放，已释放则 SESSION_DISPOSED，不发布数据。

jumpTo 不是撤销业务的事务。$hydrate 只写已知 signal 字段，未知、派生、WASM 键按 Store 自身规则跳过；computed 随依赖重算，不直接恢复派生结果、外部资源或已发出的网络请求。回放深度计数只屏蔽同步回放期间新增 history，支持嵌套 jumpTo，不屏蔽 Runtime trace / action，也不承诺取消之后调度的通知。回放 clone 失败同样经既有 CALLBACK_FAILED 分类并保留原错或 cause；$hydrate 的失败继续沿 Store 上游路径传播，不把整次回放任意异常都改成本包码。

rows: Runtime action 的非 start 事件自动生成记录；maxTrace 限制条数。
必填去掉 timestamp 的 action 对象，通常至少 name；读取自身可枚举属性后由 now() 补时间戳，再检查终态并发布。
保存原始 IRuntimeTraceEvent，独立受 maxTrace 限制，不转换事件对象。

blocks.text: Store 定义中的方法由 Store 包装成具名 action，名称通常为 debugName.方法名。成功 end 和失败 error 都会记录，error 字段只在失败时提供。$batch / $set / $hydrate 不经 Store 方法的 runTracedAction 包装，不能因此期待自动出现 action；可自行 recordAction。captureRuntimeTrace 为 false 时 trace 保持空，actions 仍接受手动记录。它关闭一条诊断订阅，不关闭状态历史，也不改变 Store 写入策略。

rows: timestamp、observable、observer，phase 为 connect / disconnect，可选 reason 为 retrack / invalidate / dispose。
timestamp、observer，phase 为 start / end / error，可选 durationMs / error。
timestamp、name，phase 为 start / end / error，可选 durationMs / error。

blocks.text: 节点描述符含 id、kind（observable / observer / computed）和可选 debugName；action 没有通用节点描述符。此联合由 reactive 维护，trace 的 timestamp 与 durationMs 使用 Runtime 的记录语义，不能假定都来自本会话 now。
actions / trace getter 每次也返回新冻结数组，但 action 条目和 trace 事件对象本身不被冻结，payload、error 等嵌套值保留引用。三条队列分别有界，不是总字节或整个应用内存上限；读取数组也会分配快照，不提供未经测量的速度结论。

记录准备中的 now、clone，回放 clone，以及 recordAction 属性读取失败由 CALLBACK_FAILED 分类。可注记、尚无身份的原生错误保留同一对象、类型和 stack；已有完整外包 source/code 则保留，冻结错误、非 Error 或身份冲突值以 cause 保留，反射身份读取失败也保留在聚合错误中。手动 record / recordAction / clear 及 jumpTo 的克隆准备抛错；自动 Store / Runtime 监听把失败交给 Runtime.reportError，phase 为 trace-listener，不反过来让已触发的正常业务写入因诊断失败而抛错。Runtime 自己负责收容 reporter 失败与宿主回退。
dispose() 无参数、同步且幂等：先把会话置为终态，再尝试 Store unsubscribe 和 trace unsubscribe 两个清理。一个清理失败直接重抛原错；多个失败生成 CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError，errors 保留全部原错。即便第一次清理抛错，重复 dispose 也不重试或再次抛错。
终态后 record / recordAction / jumpTo / clear 均先抛 SESSION_DISPOSED；history / actions / trace 仍可读取，已有队列不清空，不再由会话监听增长。它不销毁借用的 Store / Runtime；调用方仍分别负责它们的释放。开发期按需创建会话，在组件卸载或调试结束时释放，避免持续保留诊断订阅与快照工作。
构造订阅失败时，按 trace unsubscribe、Store unsubscribe 尝试回滚；若回滚全成功原样抛出主错，有清理失败则 CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError 的 errors 以主错开头，再列清理失败。订阅与单个清理异常保留实际提供者的公共身份，不强行改为本包码。

sections.id: 两个独立的响应式图工具
sections.heading: 两个独立的响应式图工具

blocks.text: getDependencyTree(root, maxDepth?) 从 observer 沿 deps 查看依赖；接受真实 Runtime effect / computed 公开句柄，或 extension 的 IObserver。getObserverTree(root, maxDepth?) 从 observable 沿 subs 反向查看订阅者；接受 signal / computed 公开句柄，或 extension 的 IObservable。它们不需要 createStoreDevTools，不建立新的业务依赖，也不拥有节点。
maxDepth 缺省 20，必须是非负安全整数；0 连根的直接边也不展开。负数、分数、NaN、无穷均同步抛 INVALID_OPTION RangeError。深度按当前读取的图关系计算，不为了演示而伪造环或图节点。

rows: observable / observer，表示本次遍历方向中的节点角色。
debugName 优先，其次 constructor.name，最后 AnonymousReactiveNode。
observable 节点的当前版本；dependency root 为 observer 时不带此字段。
本次展开的后继树节点数组。
仅当前递归路径再次遇到同一节点时为 true，此处停止展开。

blocks.text: 同一节点在两个不同分支出现的菱形共享不算循环，两边分别展开；真正路径回环才标 circular。达到深度上限直接停止，不标为 circular。Computed 兼具两个角色，因此从依赖方向是 observable 子节点，从反向订阅方向是 observer 子节点；不要把这些数据依赖与插件能力图混为一谈。

sections.id: 错误码-错误工厂与维护命令
sections.heading: 错误码、错误工厂与维护命令

blocks.text: STORE_DEVTOOLS_SOURCE 为 store.devtools；按 source / code 分支，别匹配 message。

rows: 释放后继续变更诊断会话；新建会话，不重试旧实例。
jumpTo 的 id 不在当前 history；RangeError，选仍保留的 id。
options / getter / 容量 / 回调配置或树深度不合法；options 通常为 Error，树深度为 RangeError。
未分类的记录准备回调、回放 clone 或 action 属性读取失败；修正回调，检查原错或 cause。
多个 dispose 清理失败，或构造主错并伴随回滚失败；检查 AggregateError.errors。

blocks.text: 三个错误工厂均公开，但普通使用通常不需要它们：createStoreDevtoolsError(code, message, options?) 返回带身份的原生 Error，options.cause 可省略；createStoreDevtoolsRangeError(code, message) 返回 RangeError；createStoreDevtoolsAggregateError(code, errors, message) 返回 AggregateError，errors 必填只读列表，保留全部原值，不去重。code 与 message 均必填，code 类型为 IStoreDevtoolsErrorCode；工厂不覆盖 stack。
包维护使用已有 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test、build 脚本；构建、测试及文档执行结果由实际门禁报告给出，不把本节的命令清单当作已经运行的证据。
为已有 Store 记录本地诊断历史，并读取真实响应式依赖图。最短入口见 README。

sections.id: 回放保留状态而不新增回放历史
sections.heading: 回放保留状态而不新增回放历史

blocks.text: 排查问题时，需要回到较早的 Store 状态，再从那里继续修改。
普通变更监听若把回放触发的注水也当成用户编辑，每跳转一次就会多记一条历史。
把工具接到真实 Store，保留初始 id 后调用 `jumpTo()`；会话会抑制回放产生的历史，后续真实修改仍正常记录。

runtime 是本例显式创建并交给 Store 的 Runtime。schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() 将调度改为同步，便于逐条观察；省略时 Runtime 默认通过注入的微任务调度。createStore 的初始 count 为 0，options.runtime 使用该实例；工具 captureRuntimeTrace: false 关闭自动 trace / action，仍保留状态历史。其余 maxHistory / maxTrace 为 100 / 1000，clone 为 diagnostic，now 为 Date.now。
输出：
输出为 `2 3`、`0 3`、`1 4`、`0 true`：回放恢复计数但不追加历史，后续修改继续记录，初始状态保持浅冻结。
`jumpTo` 只向 Store 已知字段注水，不会撤销外部副作用、恢复已淘汰条目，也不保证所有诊断值都完全深度隔离。

sections.id: 分别限制历史与手动动作队列
sections.heading: 分别限制历史与手动动作队列

blocks.text: 长时间调试时，需要只保留少量最近状态，同时留下选定的手动动作说明。
共用一个队列会让动作说明挤掉状态；把清空当成新会话，还可能重用旧 id，留下含混的锚点。
分别设置 `maxHistory`、`maxTrace`，关闭自动追踪并追加手动动作，再清空并检查新的初始条目。
maxHistory 和 maxTrace 均覆盖为 2，分别限制不同队列；captureRuntimeTrace 为 false 时手动 recordAction 仍可用。now: () => 100 返回确定时间戳，省略为 Date.now。recordAction.name 是说明，timestamp 由工具补；jumpTo 接收历史 id，clear 无参数且不重置序号。
输出：

blocks.code:
2,3
第二,第三 0
true UNKNOWN_HISTORY_ENTRY
5 initial 0 0

blocks.text: 输出为 `2,3`、`第二,第三 0`、`true UNKNOWN_HISTORY_ENTRY`、`5 initial 0 0`：两个队列各自保留最近条目，清空也不重置 id 序列。
`maxHistory` 默认 `100`；`maxTrace` 默认分别为 actions、trace 保留 `1000` 条，`captureRuntimeTrace: false` 也会关闭自动动作捕获。

sections.id: 报告快照失败而不打断业务写入
sections.heading: 报告快照失败而不打断业务写入

blocks.text: 普通 Store 更新期间，诊断快照回调可能失败，但业务写入仍应可用。
让该回调从 Store 监听器直接逃出，就把调试失败变成业务失败；准备完成前先占用 id，也会在失败后留下空号。
使用真实 Runtime 报告入口和会失败的克隆回调；自动捕获报告原错，手动 `record()` 则在发布前抛出它。

Runtime onError 接收真实错误，本例收集到 reports，省略时使用 Runtime 默认报告器。clone 是应用回调，这里只做浅展开；fail 开启后抛出同一个 TypeError，默认 clone 则为 diagnostic。captureRuntimeTrace 为 false 使本例只考察状态快照失败；手动 record 未传 label，默认 state change。
输出：

blocks.code:
1 1
true CALLBACK_FAILED
true
2

blocks.text: 输出为 `1 1`、`true CALLBACK_FAILED`、`true`、`2`：写入成功，自动报告保留原 TypeError，手动记录抛出同一个错误，恢复后使用下一个 id。
这里隔离的只是诊断准备失败；回放克隆的未归属失败会带 `CALLBACK_FAILED` 抛出，Store 注水仍沿自身失败路径传播；此自定义克隆仅作浅展开。

sections.id: 释放诊断会话后继续使用-store
sections.heading: 释放诊断会话后继续使用 Store

blocks.text: 调试面板关闭后，应用仍需要它刚才查看的 Store。
面板退出时连 Store 一起释放，会越过应用的所有权边界；保留诊断监听器，又会让隐藏历史继续增长。
只释放诊断会话，保留其只读队列，再继续写真实 Store；新的诊断修改会被拒绝。
dispose 不接参数、同步且幂等；释放后 record 拒绝，但 history 数组快照仍可读取。Store 与 Runtime 是借用资源，tools.dispose 不销毁它们。本例 finally 另行调用 store.$dispose；Runtime 的调度与 Store 初始值同前几例。
输出：

blocks.code:
1 1
SESSION_DISPOSED
2

blocks.text: 输出为 `1 1`、`SESSION_DISPOSED`、`2`：重复释放无额外影响，旧历史仍可读且不增长，调用方拥有的 Store 仍能写入。
会话释放只移除 Store 与 Runtime 订阅，不清空队列，也不释放借用的 Store；调用方最后单独释放 Store。

第一个,第二个

blocks.text: 输出为 `计数 合计`、`第一个,第二个`、`第二个`、`0`：重新取得的树反映了公开 effect 释放，深度为零则省略全部订阅边。

本包是已有 Store 的本地诊断会话，不创建 Store，不改写或代理写入路径。它使用 Store 的 $subscribe、$runtime.subscribeTrace / reportError、$plain、$hydrate，记录内存历史和 action，另提供两个不依赖会话的响应式图遍历函数。适合排查字段变化、动作失败和节点依赖，不是持久化审计、网络回放或外部副作用的事务回滚。
唯一入口为 `@migaia/store-devtools`，导出 createStoreDevTools、getDependencyTree、getObserverTree、五种公开数据类型、错误码与三个错误工厂。reactive、store-light、store-middleware、utils 是运行时依赖；示例直接导入 reactive / store-light 时仍应直接安装它们。

本包不实现浏览器扩展协议。要连接 Redux DevTools，使用 Store Middleware 的 createReduxDevToolsAdapter / connectDevTools。原 StoreDevtoolsCommand / IStoreDevtoolsCommand 已移出此入口；自建桥接改为从 store-middleware 导入 ReduxDevToolsCommand / IReduxDevToolsCommand。六个协议值保持 DISPATCH、COMMIT、JUMP_TO_STATE、JUMP_TO_ACTION、ROLLBACK、RESET；这是导入位置的迁移，不是新增协议层。
`createStoreDevTools<S>(store, options?)` 同步返回 IStoreDevTools。store 必须是 createStore 返回的真实 `IReactiveStore<S>`；会话借用 Store 和 Runtime，不拥有或销毁它们。options 省略为空对象。

rows: 100；仅限制 history，必须是正安全整数。
1000；分别限制 actions 和 trace 的独立队列，没有 maxActions。
缺省启用；只有严格等于 false 才完全跳过 Runtime trace 订阅，actions 也不再自动填充。
Date.now；为历史和 action 记录提供时间戳，显式提供时必须是函数。
ClonePolicy.diagnostic；接收 $plain() 或历史 state 并返回记录对象，显式提供时必须是函数。

blocks.text: null / 非对象 options 以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝；反射或 option 属性读取失败也使用该码，并在 cause 保留捕获的原错。构造读取描述符后读取五个选项，getter 可能在这些属性读取中执行；它不是“完全不执行 getter”的接纳方式。maxHistory / maxTrace 经空值回退后校验，不把 0、负数、分数、无穷或 NaN 静默夹到合法值。now / clone 的非函数配置同样在订阅前拒绝。

通过配置校验后，先同步创建第一条 initial 历史，再订阅当前 Store 的粗粒度状态通知。开启 trace 时订阅的是这个 Store 所用的整个 Runtime，因此共享 Runtime 上其他 Store 或 runTracedAction 的动作也可能进入 actions / trace；它们不自动按本 Store 身份过滤。配置失败不建立订阅；订阅建立失败则尝试释放已取得订阅，主错与回滚错误的保留方式见错误章节。

rows: 每次读取返回按时间顺序排列的新冻结数组，元素为 IStoreHistoryEntry。
label 默认 state change；先准备时间戳和状态，再分配 id、追加记录，并返回该条目。
必填历史 id；找不到（含已裁剪）抛 UNKNOWN_HISTORY_ENTRY RangeError，找到则 clone(state) 后交给 Store 的 $hydrate。
无参数；先准备新的 initial，再清三队列并发布这一条，id 继续递增，不归零。

blocks.text: IStoreHistoryEntry 含 id、timestamp、label、state；公开字段类型没有额外 readonly 修饰，但发布时 entry 与 state 顶层实际冻结。history 的数组快照不随之后入队而变化，嵌套 state 的隔离程度由 clone 决定，不保证任意对象图深冻结。超出 maxHistory 后淘汰最早条目，包括 initial；保留已裁剪 id 也不能继续 jumpTo。

默认 record 从 clone(store.$plain()) 取状态。$plain 只包含 Store 的 signal 支撑字段，不含 computed、方法或 WASM 字段。默认 diagnostic clone 通过公共 structured-clone-first owner 尽力复制；不可克隆或不安全子树可能保持引用，自定义类也不保证原型保持。它不自动脱敏；需要剔除 token 等字段时，应用应提供明确的 clone，或不让敏感值进入可记录状态。
record / clear 的准备失败不发布半条历史，也不消耗下一个 id；clear 准备失败保留全部旧队列。准备完成后还会检查会话是否已被回调释放，已释放则 SESSION_DISPOSED，不发布数据。

jumpTo 不是撤销业务的事务。$hydrate 只写已知 signal 字段，未知、派生、WASM 键按 Store 自身规则跳过；computed 随依赖重算，不直接恢复派生结果、外部资源或已发出的网络请求。回放深度计数只屏蔽同步回放期间新增 history，支持嵌套 jumpTo，不屏蔽 Runtime trace / action，也不承诺取消之后调度的通知。回放 clone 失败同样经既有 CALLBACK_FAILED 分类并保留原错或 cause；$hydrate 的失败继续沿 Store 上游路径传播，不把整次回放任意异常都改成本包码。

rows: Runtime action 的非 start 事件自动生成记录；maxTrace 限制条数。
必填去掉 timestamp 的 action 对象，通常至少 name；读取自身可枚举属性后由 now() 补时间戳，再检查终态并发布。
保存原始 IRuntimeTraceEvent，独立受 maxTrace 限制，不转换事件对象。

blocks.text: Store 定义中的方法由 Store 包装成具名 action，名称通常为 debugName.方法名。成功 end 和失败 error 都会记录，error 字段只在失败时提供。$batch / $set / $hydrate 不经 Store 方法的 runTracedAction 包装，不能因此期待自动出现 action；可自行 recordAction。captureRuntimeTrace 为 false 时 trace 保持空，actions 仍接受手动记录。它关闭一条诊断订阅，不关闭状态历史，也不改变 Store 写入策略。

rows: timestamp、observable、observer，phase 为 connect / disconnect，可选 reason 为 retrack / invalidate / dispose。
timestamp、observer，phase 为 start / end / error，可选 durationMs / error。
timestamp、name，phase 为 start / end / error，可选 durationMs / error。

blocks.text: 节点描述符含 id、kind（observable / observer / computed）和可选 debugName；action 没有通用节点描述符。此联合由 reactive 维护，trace 的 timestamp 与 durationMs 使用 Runtime 的记录语义，不能假定都来自本会话 now。
actions / trace getter 每次也返回新冻结数组，但 action 条目和 trace 事件对象本身不被冻结，payload、error 等嵌套值保留引用。三条队列分别有界，不是总字节或整个应用内存上限；读取数组也会分配快照，不提供未经测量的速度结论。

记录准备中的 now、clone，回放 clone，以及 recordAction 属性读取失败由 CALLBACK_FAILED 分类。可注记、尚无身份的原生错误保留同一对象、类型和 stack；已有完整外包 source/code 则保留，冻结错误、非 Error 或身份冲突值以 cause 保留，反射身份读取失败也保留在聚合错误中。手动 record / recordAction / clear 及 jumpTo 的克隆准备抛错；自动 Store / Runtime 监听把失败交给 Runtime.reportError，phase 为 trace-listener，不反过来让已触发的正常业务写入因诊断失败而抛错。Runtime 自己负责收容 reporter 失败与宿主回退。
dispose() 无参数、同步且幂等：先把会话置为终态，再尝试 Store unsubscribe 和 trace unsubscribe 两个清理。一个清理失败直接重抛原错；多个失败生成 CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError，errors 保留全部原错。即便第一次清理抛错，重复 dispose 也不重试或再次抛错。
终态后 record / recordAction / jumpTo / clear 均先抛 SESSION_DISPOSED；history / actions / trace 仍可读取，已有队列不清空，不再由会话监听增长。它不销毁借用的 Store / Runtime；调用方仍分别负责它们的释放。开发期按需创建会话，在组件卸载或调试结束时释放，避免持续保留诊断订阅与快照工作。
构造订阅失败时，按 trace unsubscribe、Store unsubscribe 尝试回滚；若回滚全成功原样抛出主错，有清理失败则 CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError 的 errors 以主错开头，再列清理失败。订阅与单个清理异常保留实际提供者的公共身份，不强行改为本包码。

blocks.text: STORE_DEVTOOLS_SOURCE 为 store.devtools；按 source / code 分支，别匹配 message。

Attach bounded local history, state replay, and action tracing to an existing Store, and inspect its real reactive dependencies.

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: Jumping to an old state adds another history entry because a change listener treats replay writes as user edits.
Action notes evict needed states because history and tracing share one retention limit.
A failed debugging snapshot turns a business write into an exception because its callback is not isolated.
Closing a debug panel destroys the Store because session ownership is confused with application ownership.
The second path to a shared dependency disappears because a global visited set mistakes a diamond for a cycle.

Replay state without recording synchronous replay as another edit. Instead of adding a separate replay switch around a change listener, the example keeps history length stable during a jump and records the next edit, as shown in the scenario.

Retain recent history and actions independently. Rather than mixing notes and states in one capacity, the example demonstrates separate eviction and increasing ids after clear, as shown in the scenario.

Report automatic snapshot failure while completing the business write. The example keeps the diagnostic callback from breaking that write and checks original-error identity, manual failure, and the next recovered id in the scenario.
Release diagnostics without destroying the application Store. The example stops hidden history growth while leaving the Store writable, separating panel closure from state ownership in the scenario.
Keep both paths to a shared dependency. Rather than truncating a diamond with a global visited set, the example expands real Runtime nodes along both paths and checks zero depth in the scenario.

blocks.text: Save overview.ts in an ESM project and run it with Node 24; first install the diagnostics module and directly imported Store module:

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/store-devtools @migaia/store-light

blocks.text: Output:
For queue retention, see Bound history and manual action queues independently; for recomputation sources, see Expand both paths of a shared dependency.

createStore starts at count 0 and borrows the default Runtime when runtime is omitted. Explicit flush completes this change notification before replay. captureRuntimeTrace false overrides enabled capture. Other defaults are maxHistory 100, maxTrace 1000, diagnostic clone, and Date.now. Cleanup releases the session and Store separately.
The same state-replay task, displayed without execution:

blocks.code:
import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'

const store = createStore({ count: 0 })
const history = [store.$plain()]
const off = store.$subscribe(() => history.push(store.$plain())) // History has no retention bound
store.count = 1
store.$runtime.flush()
store.$hydrate(history[0]!)
store.$runtime.flush() // Replay adds history again, indistinguishable from an edit
void off // The panel still has not released its subscription

blocks.text: The preceding example uses jumpTo to suppress synchronous replay history and releases the diagnostic subscription in finally. The Store creator still disposes the Store separately. This handwritten version only displays the pitfalls of that same task and is not executed.

blocks.text: This module adds a local diagnostic session to an existing Store. It neither creates the Store nor rewrites or proxies its mutation path. It uses the Store's $subscribe, $runtime.subscribeTrace / reportError, $plain, and $hydrate, records in-memory history and actions, and exposes two independent reactive graph traversals. Use it to investigate state changes, failed actions, and dependencies; it is not durable auditing, network replay, or transactional reversal of external effects.

The only entry is `@migaia/store-devtools`. It exports createStoreDevTools, getDependencyTree, getObserverTree, five public data types, error codes, and three error factories. reactive, store-light, store-middleware, and utils are runtime dependencies. Still install reactive / store-light directly when your examples import them.

This module does not implement the browser extension protocol. Use Store Middleware and its createReduxDevToolsAdapter / connectDevTools for Redux DevTools. StoreDevtoolsCommand / IStoreDevtoolsCommand were removed from this entry; custom bridges import ReduxDevToolsCommand / IReduxDevToolsCommand from store-middleware. DISPATCH, COMMIT, JUMP_TO_STATE, JUMP_TO_ACTION, ROLLBACK, and RESET retain their values. This is an import migration, not another protocol layer.

`createStoreDevTools<S>(store, options?)` synchronously returns IStoreDevTools. store must be a real `IReactiveStore<S>` returned by createStore. The session borrows its Store and Runtime rather than disposing them. Omitted options is an empty object.

rows: 100; bounds history only and must be a positive safe integer.
1000; independently bounds actions and trace, with no maxActions option.
Enabled unless strictly false; false skips the Runtime trace subscription and automatic action capture.
Date.now; timestamps history and action records, and must be a function when supplied.
ClonePolicy.diagnostic; receives $plain() or retained history state and returns a record, and must be a function when supplied.

blocks.text: Null / non-object options produce INVALID_OPTION. Failed reflection or option-property reads use the same code and preserve the caught failure on cause. Construction obtains descriptors and then reads the five options; getters can run during those property reads. This admission does not promise to avoid all getters. Queue limits use nullish defaults before validation, rejecting zero, negatives, fractions, infinity, and NaN rather than clamping them. Non-function now / clone options also reject before subscription.

After configuration admission, construction synchronously records the initial entry, then subscribes to coarse changes of the selected Store. Trace capture subscribes to that Store's entire Runtime. Actions from another Store or runTracedAction on a shared Runtime can therefore appear; they are not automatically filtered to this Store. Invalid configuration acquires no subscriptions. A later subscription failure rolls back those already acquired; error retention is described below.

rows: Each read returns a new frozen chronological array of IStoreHistoryEntry values.
Defaults label to state change; prepares timestamp and state before allocating an id, appending, and returning the entry.
Requires a retained history id; missing or evicted ids produce UNKNOWN_HISTORY_ENTRY RangeError, otherwise clone(state) is passed to Store $hydrate.
Takes no arguments; prepares a replacement initial before clearing all three queues and publishing it, without resetting the id sequence.

blocks.text: IStoreHistoryEntry contains id, timestamp, label, and state. Its public fields have no additional readonly modifiers, but the published entry and top level of state are frozen. An array snapshot does not grow with later publication. Nested independence depends on clone rather than deep freezing every possible graph. maxHistory evicts the oldest entries, including initial; retaining an evicted id does not make it a valid jump target.

record obtains clone(store.$plain()). $plain includes signal-backed Store fields, excluding computed values, methods, and WASM fields. Default diagnostic cloning uses the shared structured-clone-first implementation for a best-effort copy. Unsupported or unsafe subtrees can remain aliases, and custom class prototypes need not survive. It does not redact secrets. Provide an explicit clone to remove tokens or other sensitive fields, or keep them outside recorded state.

Failed record / clear preparation publishes no partial history and consumes no id. Failed clear preparation preserves all existing queues. Preparation also rechecks whether a callback disposed the session; if so it throws SESSION_DISPOSED rather than publishing.

jumpTo is not a business transaction rollback. $hydrate writes known signal fields and follows the Store's own rules for ignoring unknown, derived, or WASM keys. Computed values recalculate from dependencies; external resources and already sent requests are not restored. blocks.text: Save each scenario as an independent .ts file and run it in an ESM project with Node 24. They use real Stores, Runtimes, and public handles without a browser extension.

sections.heading: Replay retained state without creating replay history

blocks.text: An investigation needs to revisit an earlier Store state and then continue editing from it.
A plain change listener can record the hydration caused by replay as another user edit, making the history grow every time the investigator jumps.
Attach tools to a real Store, retain its initial id, and call jumpTo(); the session suppresses replay-generated history while later edits still record.

This example explicitly creates a Runtime and passes it to the Store. schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() makes scheduling synchronous for stepwise observation; omission uses Runtime's injected microtask scheduling. The Store begins with count 0 and options.runtime selects that instance. captureRuntimeTrace false disables automatic trace / actions without disabling state history. Other defaults are maxHistory 100, maxTrace 1000, diagnostic clone, and Date.now.
Output:
Output is `2 3`, `0 3`, `1 4`, then `0 true`: replay restores count without extending history, the next edit records again, and the initial state stays shallow-frozen.
jumpTo hydrates retained Store fields; it does not undo external side effects, restore evicted entries, or guarantee deep isolation for every diagnostic value.

sections.heading: Bound history and manual action queues independently

blocks.text: A long debugging session needs a small recent history while still retaining selected manual action notes.
One shared queue can make action notes evict states, and treating clear as a fresh session can reuse old ids or leave ambiguous anchors.
Set independent maxHistory and maxTrace limits, disable automatic trace, add manual actions, then clear and inspect the new initial entry.

maxHistory and maxTrace are both overridden to 2 but bound separate queues. Manual recordAction remains available with captureRuntimeTrace false. now: () => 100 supplies a deterministic timestamp, replacing Date.now. recordAction.name is its note and tools supplies timestamp. jumpTo takes a history id; clear takes no arguments and does not reset ids.
Output:

blocks.code:
2,3
second,third 0
true UNKNOWN_HISTORY_ENTRY
5 initial 0 0

blocks.text: Output is `2,3`, `second,third 0`, `true UNKNOWN_HISTORY_ENTRY`, then `5 initial 0 0`: queues keep their own newest entries and clear preserves the id sequence.
maxHistory defaults to 100; maxTrace defaults to 1000 for each of actions and trace, and captureRuntimeTrace false also disables automatic action capture.

sections.heading: Report snapshot failure without interrupting the business write

blocks.text: A diagnostic snapshot callback fails during an ordinary Store update, but the update must remain usable.
Letting that callback escape the Store listener turns a debugging failure into a business failure; reserving an id before preparation also leaves a hole after failure.
Use the real Runtime reporter and a failing clone callback; automatic capture reports the original error, while manual record throws it before publishing.

Runtime onError receives the actual error, collected in reports here; omission uses Runtime's default reporter. The custom clone only spreads the top level, throwing the same TypeError after fail is enabled; the default clone is diagnostic. captureRuntimeTrace false keeps this example focused on state snapshots. Omitted record label defaults to state change.
Output:

blocks.code:
1 1
true CALLBACK_FAILED
true
2

blocks.text: Output is `1 1`, `true CALLBACK_FAILED`, `true`, then `2`: the write succeeds, automatic reporting keeps the original TypeError, manual recording throws it, and recovery uses the next id.
Only diagnostic preparation is isolated here; unclassified replay clone failures throw with `CALLBACK_FAILED`, while Store hydration keeps its own failure path; this custom clone is a shallow spread.

sections.heading: Release diagnostics while leaving the Store usable

blocks.text: A debugging panel closes, while the application still needs the Store it was inspecting.
Disposing the Store with the panel releases a resource owned by the application, but keeping the diagnostic listeners attached makes hidden history keep growing.
Dispose only the diagnostic session, retain its read-only queues, and continue writing the real Store; new diagnostic mutations reject.

dispose takes no arguments, is synchronous and idempotent, and retires record while leaving history readable. The Store and Runtime are borrowed, so tools.dispose does not destroy them. finally separately calls store.$dispose. Runtime scheduling and Store initial state follow the preceding examples.
Output:

blocks.code:
1 1
SESSION_DISPOSED
2

blocks.text: Output is `1 1`, `SESSION_DISPOSED`, then `2`: repeated disposal is harmless, the old history remains readable and unchanged, and the caller-owned Store still accepts writes.
Session dispose detaches its Store and Runtime subscriptions; it does not clear queues or dispose the borrowed Store, which the caller releases separately.

sections.heading: Expand both paths of a shared dependency

blocks.text: Two computed values share one signal, and an effect reads both; an investigation needs to see both paths back to that signal.
A global visited set can label the second shared path as a cycle or omit it, even though that path does not recurse into itself.
Build the diamond with real Runtime handles and inspect the effect; traversal tracks only the current path and respects an explicit depth bound.

The source signal starts at 1. left / right read it and the effect reads both computed values, creating real dependencies. debugName labels diagnostics; tree labels otherwise fall back to constructor.name and AnonymousReactiveNode. getDependencyTree defaults maxDepth to 20, while explicit 0 leaves direct edges unexpanded. The function does not own these handles, so their creator releases them.
Output:

blocks.code:
view left,right
source,source
true
0

blocks.text: Output is `view left,right`, `source,source`, `true`, then `0`: both shared paths expand without a cycle flag, and maxDepth zero returns no direct edges.
The default depth is 20 and must be a nonnegative safe integer; this is an instantaneous upstream view, not a new subscription or an effect execution.

sections.heading: Find current subscribers after an effect releases its subscription

blocks.text: A signal feeds a computed value and two effects, but one panel has already stopped observing it.
A separately maintained subscriber list can retain the closed panel and mislead an investigation into what can still rerun.
Read the real signal's downstream tree, dispose one effect through its public handle, and inspect again without creating a diagnostic session.

count starts at 2, total computes count × 2, and both effects read total. debugName labels the nodes. getObserverTree accepts real signal / computed handles, defaults maxDepth to 20, and returns only the root at 0. Its returned tree is not a live subscription; call it again after first.dispose to read current relationships.
Output:

blocks.code:
count total
first,second
second
0

blocks.text: Output is `count total`, `first,second`, `second`, then `0`: the fresh tree reflects public effect disposal, while a zero depth omits all subscriber edges.
The default depth is 20; returned trees are point-in-time data and do not update themselves after another subscription change.

This module adds a local diagnostic session to an existing Store. It neither creates the Store nor rewrites or proxies its mutation path. It uses the Store's $subscribe, $runtime.subscribeTrace / reportError, $plain, and $hydrate, records in-memory history and actions, and exposes two independent reactive graph traversals. Use it to investigate state changes, failed actions, and dependencies; it is not durable auditing, network replay, or transactional reversal of external effects.

The only entry is `@migaia/store-devtools`. It exports createStoreDevTools, getDependencyTree, getObserverTree, five public data types, error codes, and three error factories. reactive, store-light, store-middleware, and utils are runtime dependencies. Still install reactive / store-light directly when your examples import them.

This module does not implement the browser extension protocol. Use Store Middleware and its createReduxDevToolsAdapter / connectDevTools for Redux DevTools. StoreDevtoolsCommand / IStoreDevtoolsCommand were removed from this entry; custom bridges import ReduxDevToolsCommand / IReduxDevToolsCommand from store-middleware. DISPATCH, COMMIT, JUMP_TO_STATE, JUMP_TO_ACTION, ROLLBACK, and RESET retain their values. This is an import migration, not another protocol layer.

`createStoreDevTools<S>(store, options?)` synchronously returns IStoreDevTools. store must be a real `IReactiveStore<S>` returned by createStore. The session borrows its Store and Runtime rather than disposing them. Omitted options is an empty object.

blocks.text: Null / non-object options produce INVALID_OPTION. Failed reflection or option-property reads use the same code and preserve the caught failure on cause. Construction obtains descriptors and then reads the five options; getters can run during those property reads. This admission does not promise to avoid all getters. Queue limits use nullish defaults before validation, rejecting zero, negatives, fractions, infinity, and NaN rather than clamping them. Non-function now / clone options also reject before subscription.

After configuration admission, construction synchronously records the initial entry, then subscribes to coarse changes of the selected Store. Trace capture subscribes to that Store's entire Runtime. Actions from another Store or runTracedAction on a shared Runtime can therefore appear; they are not automatically filtered to this Store. Invalid configuration acquires no subscriptions. A later subscription failure rolls back those already acquired; error retention is described below.
